items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I see, in this production of "Salome," that at the very bottom of the list of cast, the dancer is Wesley Gale. I know he's still around.

ctx.x: Oh, a long time. She was...and then she...her biggest cast character, I think, was in "Anna Lucasta." That was the last one she was in, I think--big travelling show.
I see, in this production of "Salome," that at the very bottom of the list of cast, the dancer is Wesley Gale. I know he's still around.
